$comment: Copy this file, rename without leading underscore, and fill in values. Do not commit real PII.
description: Example template for a non-disclosure agreement. Each document type must define its own fields.

fields.name: disclosingParty
fields.description: Legal name of the party disclosing confidential information

fields.name: receivingParty
fields.description: Legal name of the party receiving confidential information

fields.name: effectiveDate
fields.description: Agreement effective date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

fields.name: termMonths
fields.description: Contract term length in months, if stated

fields.name: signaturePresent
fields.description: Whether at least one signature appears to be present (metadata only; no image crops)

_identityPairedExample.description: Example parent key for a paired identity document. Child side schemas live in sides.front and sides.back.

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full name as printed on the front of the document

fields.name: address
fields.description: Residential address if printed on the back
